dependencies.dependency: Versioned exact-Run fetch-stream SSE with frozen normalized envelope, effects and payloads
AtomicRunProjectionV1 at a durable projection_sequence/revision watermark
Pre-header cursor validation, strict numeric/opaque replay and terminal-at-cursor close
Research Path consumes authoritative actual-graph Tasks; same-Task correction and Lead-approved graph mutation projection
Durable PostgreSQL event/checkpoint composition plus externally supervised backend/PostgreSQL restart
dependencies.required_evidence: P4-BE-017, P4-ID-023 and P4-E2E-098 live evidence

controls.precondition: integrated nonterminal exact Run and production HTTP route registration
controls.expected_result: HTTP 200 is real text/event-stream/no-cache and carries exact core/event contract headers

controls.precondition: captured live SSE bytes with arbitrary UTF-8/chunk/line boundaries
controls.expected_result: named frame id/type/data and all 12 normalized envelope fields validate exactly; malformed/truncated data is quarantined

controls.precondition: live normalized event stream
controls.expected_result: 55 raw values are recognized, exactly 47 V1 values are admitted, 8 frozen unsupported values cause UNSUPPORTED_EVENT/zero mutation

controls.precondition: supported live event
controls.expected_result: effect is exact PATCH_PROJECTION/REFRESH_PROJECTION/OBSERVATION_ONLY/TERMINAL and refresh flag is mechanically consistent

controls.precondition: distinct real Run A/Run B and their authoritative Task sets
controls.expected_result: URL/frame/task remain exact Run-scoped; wrong Run/Task and latest/global fallback are quarantined without mutation

controls.precondition: snapshot at N and contiguous live/replayed suffix
controls.expected_result: only N+1 is admitted, committed sequence is monotonic and durable event IDs are not reused

controls.precondition: byte/semantic-identical already applied event is replayed
controls.expected_result: exact duplicate is DUPLICATE_IGNORED with zero cursor/domain/cardinality change

controls.precondition: complete real frames are duplicated with conflicting content, delayed, reordered or dropped by an external byte-preserving proxy
controls.expected_result: conflict/gap/out-of-order/stale unseen frame is quarantined, cursor does not advance and one authoritative recovery is required

controls.precondition: real nonterminal stream remains idle through configured heartbeat interval
controls.expected_result: heartbeat is an SSE comment with no sequence, event, cursor or business-state mutation

controls.precondition: each supported runtime family is exercised by a real Run
controls.expected_result: required/literal/optional payload fields are exact; unknown fields, unsafe detail, bad status/progress/version fail closed

controls.precondition: real Run reaches valid released terminal state
controls.expected_result: one release.completed precedes one final run.completed; stream intentionally closes and emits no later business frame

controls.contract_section_ref: runtime event focused addenda; §§13-14 TerminalFailureV1 / UAC-011
controls.precondition: ordinary controlled real input causes terminal failure/cancellation
controls.expected_result: one final run.failed carries exact FAILED/CANCELLED status, required 11-value failure_stage, stable failure_code, and optional safe_message; stream closes and no released success is fabricated

controls.precondition: exact Run has atomic projection at revision P/sequence N
controls.expected_result: Object/Run/Goal/Scheme/graphs/Tasks/path changes/terminal identity closes at one non-regressing revision/watermark

controls.precondition: durable same-Run cursor N is within tail
controls.expected_result: Last-Event-ID N returns strict contiguous suffix beginning N+1 with no prefix replay

controls.precondition: exact opaque event_id at N and paired numeric N requests
controls.expected_result: same-Run opaque and numeric cursors return equivalent suffixes; foreign opaque ID is INVALID_CURSOR

controls.precondition: negative, signed, whitespace, noncanonical, malformed, unknown or cross-Run cursor
controls.expected_result: pre-SSE JSON HTTP 400 INVALID_CURSOR/retryable=false/SNAPSHOT_RELOAD with zero frame/foreign disclosure

controls.precondition: numeric cursor exceeds durable Run tail
controls.expected_result: pre-SSE JSON HTTP 409 CURSOR_AHEAD/retryable=false/SNAPSHOT_RELOAD; no clamp, heartbeat or replay-zero fallback

controls.precondition: external proxy closes after complete committed frame N while Run continues
controls.expected_result: last valid business state is retained; bounded reconnect uses N and snapshot prefix plus suffix covers durable 1..M

controls.precondition: real N+1 commits after atomic snapshot S_N and before subscription
controls.expected_result: subscription sends N, receives N+1, applies each later fact once and converges to a fresh backend projection

controls.precondition: route switches Run A to Run B while delayed Run A response/frame arrives
controls.expected_result: obsolete A stream is aborted/quarantined and cannot mutate B; one exact B subscription remains

controls.precondition: nonterminal stream disconnects without a backend business failure
controls.expected_result: transport RECOVERING/BACKOFF is not Run FAILED, creates no Run and preserves the exact last valid snapshot visibly stale

controls.precondition: cursor equals durable terminal sequence
controls.expected_result: HTTP 200 SSE carries terminal headers, zero business/heartbeat frames and closes immediately without reconnect

controls.precondition: Parent restarts actual backend and PostgreSQL on the same isolated durable volume/build/revision
controls.expected_result: exact Run projection/event suffix/graph/path history and terminal behavior survive real process boundaries without identity substitution

controls.precondition: atomic snapshot contains authoritative actual-graph Tasks
controls.expected_result: Research Path has exactly the same Task IDs/raw statuses/dependencies and no Scheme/registry/report-fabricated node

controls.precondition: graph.task_added/edge/version sparse event is received
controls.expected_result: event never constructs a Task/body/edge locally; it requires one exact atomic projection refresh

controls.precondition: real task.self_correcting then task.correction_resolved and refreshed projection
controls.expected_result: same Run/Task/actual graph/version/topology and immutable plan; one CORRECTION/SELF_CORRECTION path row, no graph operation/new Task/Run

controls.precondition: Specialist creates one PENDING ReplanRequest
controls.expected_result: pending path row is visible but actual/planned graph identity/version/topology remain unchanged and no graph event exists

controls.contract_section_ref: API §6 approved operations; Event §3 graph lifecycle
controls.precondition: request PENDING, exact Research Lead approval and graph mutation events/projection
controls.expected_result: request precedes approval; every graph event follows approval and shares replan_id; add_node/add_edge/remove_edge delta applies exactly once with one version increment

controls.precondition: specialist request, approved decision and local correction are exercised
controls.expected_result: Specialist/local correction cannot directly mutate graph; only Research Lead approved Replan changes actual graph and planned graph never changes
